objects.description: Strongly-typed enumeration of CUTLASS operation status/result codes indicating success or specific error conditions. Useful for returning and interpreting outcomes of library calls. No additional storage or ownership semantics apply.

functions.name: cutlass::cutlassGetStatusString
functions.description: Returns a human-readable string describing a CUTLASS Status value. Usable from host or device code. Typical usage is to map a Status returned by a CUTLASS API to a log/error message. For unknown or invalid Status values, it returns "Invalid status".
requirements: Argument status should be a valid cutlass::Status enumerator; otherwise the function returns "Invalid status".
May be called from host or device code (annotated CUTLASS_HOST_DEVICE).
No side effects; returned pointer refers to a static string literal and must not be modified or freed.

functions.name: cutlass::thread0
functions.description: Returns true only for thread 0 of threadblock 0 (i.e., when threadIdx.{x,y,z} and blockIdx.{x,y,z} are all zero) when called from device code. Returns false when called from host code. Useful for emitting one-time prints or performing setup by a single thread.
requirements: When compiled for device (__CUDA_ARCH__ defined), the predicate is based on CUDA’s threadIdx and blockIdx builtin variables.
On host (when not compiling for device), this function always returns false; do not rely on it to be true on the host.

functions.name: cutlass::canonical_lane_idx
functions.description: Returns the calling thread’s lane index within its warp, computed as threadIdx.x % 32. Intended for device use; can be called when warp threads are not converged.
requirements: Must be called from device code (annotated CUTLASS_DEVICE); on host it returns 0 due to the fallback path.
Lane index is in the range [0, 31] and is derived solely from threadIdx.x (ignores threadIdx.y/z).
Does not synchronize or assume convergence of warp threads.

functions.name: cutlass::canonical_warp_idx_sync
functions.description: Returns a warp-uniform value of the calling warp’s index within the CTA, computed as threadIdx.x / 32 and broadcast using __shfl_sync. Intended for cases where threads in the warp are converged so that a uniform value is required.
requirements: Must be called from device code (annotated CUTLASS_DEVICE); on host it returns 0 due to the fallback path.
Threads within the warp must be converged; the function uses __shfl_sync with mask 0xffffffff to broadcast from lane 0.
Warp index is computed solely from threadIdx.x (ignores threadIdx.y/z).

functions.name: cutlass::canonical_warp_idx
functions.description: Returns the calling thread’s warp index within the CTA, computed as threadIdx.x / 32, without synchronizing or requiring warp convergence. Faster and allows forward progress when threads are divergent.
requirements: Must be called from device code (annotated CUTLASS_DEVICE); on host it returns 0 due to the fallback path.
Does not synchronize the warp; safe to call when threads are not converged.
Warp index is computed solely from threadIdx.x (ignores threadIdx.y/z).

functions.name: cutlass::canonical_warp_group_idx
functions.description: Returns a warp-uniform value indicating the calling warp’s group index within the CTA, where a warp group is 128 threads (4 warps). Computed as threadIdx.x / 128 and broadcast via __shfl_sync. Useful when organizing warps into groups of four.
requirements: Must be called from device code (annotated CUTLASS_DEVICE); on host it returns 0 due to the fallback path.
Threads within the warp must be converged; uses __shfl_sync with mask 0xffffffff to broadcast from lane 0.
Group index is computed solely from threadIdx.x (ignores threadIdx.y/z).
